what: Grooves in chrome: filtered, pumping, robotic. Press PLAY and Daurade plays a filtered loop that opens over sixteen bars, a mix that pumps on every kick, a robot voice singing the hook and crisp drums. Ten styles; steer it with four knobs, drop it, set off a solo or play the lead yourself.
author: delirioux
